summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the EDURANT (rilpivirine) NDA202022. The applicant submitted a justification for waiver, and the Division and Office Directors agreed the NDA would not be presented to the Antiviral Products Advisory Committee because rilpivirine was the fifth NNRTI in its class with a non-controversial risk/benefit profile and no significant scientific questions requiring outside expertise. Because no committee met, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
